add.description: Choose a discovered OpenCloseStop motor zone. Home Assistant estimates position from calibrated movement time; the Lutron processor does not report a physical percentage.
add.title: Add an estimated cover

add_method.description: Set up {zone}. Guided calibration measures the motor and is recommended. Manual timing does not move the motor and is useful when reliable measurements are already known.
add_method.title: Choose setup method

advanced_add.description: Select the physical control whose button or gesture should operate this cover.
advanced_add.title: Add an advanced mapping

advanced_binding.description: Map one action from {keypad}. Long press is offered only when HomeWorks QSX exposes a native LongHold event. One Pico button and gesture can control only one estimated cover.
advanced_binding.title: Configure action mapping

advanced_mappings.description: Advanced mappings can use an individual button with press, release, multi-tap, or a native long-press. They are stored in the same canonical list as standard and learned actions.
advanced_mappings.title: Advanced Pico and keypad mappings

advanced_remove.description: Select exactly one canonical mapping to remove.
advanced_remove.title: Remove an action mapping

binding_conflict.description: This Pico button and gesture is already assigned to another estimated cover. No mapping was staged.
binding_conflict.title: Action is assigned elsewhere

calibrate.description: Calibrate {zone} with two complete movements in each direction. Home Assistant compares the samples and requests a third only when the first two differ by more than 0.75 seconds. Mapped Pico calibration is offered only when this cover has Open, Close, and Stop actions.
calibrate.title: Choose a calibration method

calibrate_pico.description: This calibration measures full Open and Close travel while you operate a mapped physical Pico or keypad. At every endpoint, use a mapped Stop action as soon as movement is visibly complete; that timing is later prorated to estimate partial positions. Home Assistant listens only, so it does not duplicate the Lutron processor's commands. It first establishes fully closed without timing that positioning movement, then measures Open 1, Close 1, Open 2, and Close 2. You may use any compatible mapped action shown here: {controls}.
calibrate_pico.title: Calibrate with mapped Pico controls

calibration_ha_at_endpoint.title: The cover is already at this endpoint

calibration_ha_endpoint_error.description: Home Assistant could not send the safety Stop used to confirm this endpoint. Check the cover before retrying.
calibration_ha_endpoint_error.title: Could not confirm endpoint

calibration_ha_error.description: Home Assistant could not start this movement. No timing was saved.
calibration_ha_error.title: Movement did not start

calibration_ha_finish.description: The cover is {direction}. The moment it is {endpoint}, select **Stop now** immediately. {timing_guidance} Step: {step}.
calibration_ha_finish.title: Stop at the endpoint

calibration_ha_start.description: When you select **Start movement**, Home Assistant will begin {direction} the cover and immediately show a Stop screen. Watch the cover and select Stop the moment it is {endpoint}. {timing_guidance} Step: {step}.

menu_options.calibration_ha_at_endpoint: The cover is already at this endpoint

calibration_ha_start.title: Prepare the next movement

calibration_leg_complete.description: {step} is complete. Recorded duration: {duration}. Continue when you are ready for the next instruction.
calibration_leg_complete.title: Calibration step complete

calibration_pico_endpoint_error.description: Home Assistant could not send the safety Stop used to confirm this endpoint. Check the cover before retrying.
calibration_pico_endpoint_error.title: Could not confirm endpoint

calibration_pico_positioning.description: Calibration first needs a known starting endpoint: {endpoint}. This positioning step is not timed and will not be included in the travel-time result. If the cover needs to move, choose **Listen for the positioning movement**, use any mapped direction action ({direction_bindings}), then use any mapped Stop action ({stop_bindings}) as soon as it reaches {endpoint}. If the cover is already visibly {endpoint}, choose that option instead; Home Assistant sends a safety Stop and continues without movement or a recorded sample.

menu_options.calibration_pico_at_endpoint: The cover is already at this endpoint

calibration_pico_positioning.title: Establish the starting endpoint

calibration_pico_progress.description: Home Assistant is listening for any compatible mapped direction action ({direction_bindings}), the corresponding motor-zone update, and then any mapped Stop action ({stop_bindings}). Use Stop immediately when the cover is {endpoint}.
calibration_pico_progress.title: Listening for calibration movement

calibration_pico_retry.description: The expected sequence was not completed for {step}. The error above identifies whether the direction action, motor-zone update, or Stop action was missing. Review the mapped controls and retry. Home Assistant sends Stop whenever it believes the motor may still be moving.
calibration_pico_retry.title: Retry Pico calibration

calibration_pico_sample.description: Select **Listen**, then use any mapped direction action ({direction_bindings}). The moment the cover is {endpoint}, use any mapped Stop action ({stop_bindings}). Home Assistant measures from the observed direction event to the Stop event and does not send duplicate movement commands.
calibration_pico_sample.title: Prepare the next Pico movement

calibration_positioning_complete.description: The cover is confirmed {endpoint}. No duration was recorded because this established a known endpoint; it was not a calibration sample. You are ready for {next_step}.
calibration_positioning_complete.title: Starting position confirmed

calibration_start_error.description: Home Assistant could not reserve a safe setup session. No motor command was sent and no timing was changed.
calibration_start_error.title: Calibration could not start

data_description.close_endpoint_guard_seconds: Extra time, in tenths of a second if needed, used only when driving fully closed. It absorbs timing and motor variation so the physical endpoint is reliably reached.
data_description.close_travel_seconds: Proposed from the close samples. Adjust it here if observation or a known measurement is more reliable.
data_description.open_endpoint_guard_seconds: Extra time, in tenths of a second if needed, used only when driving fully open. It absorbs timing and motor variation so the physical endpoint is reliably reached.
data_description.open_travel_seconds: Proposed from the open samples. Adjust it here if observation or a known measurement is more reliable.

calibration_summary.description: Open samples: {open_samples}; spread {open_spread}s; proposed {open_time}s. Close samples: {close_samples}; spread {close_spread}s; proposed {close_time}s. You may edit the effective travel times before saving. Endpoint guards are independent extra run times used only for 0%, 100%, and synchronization—not for ordinary partial moves.
calibration_summary.title: Review calibration

configure.description: Choose a cover to edit. Changes stay with that cover until you select **Save and finish**.
configure.title: Configure an estimated cover

discard_changes.description: This cover has changes that have not been saved. Discard them and return to the cover list, or go back to continue editing.
discard_changes.title: Discard unsaved changes?

init.description: Estimated covers add percentage control to Lutron OpenCloseStop motor zones by timing movement. Physical position is not reported by Lutron, so synchronization and clear Pico mappings matter.
init.title: Estimated OpenCloseStop covers

learn_action.description: Learn another action or review what is already assigned. Standard Picos: {standard_picos}. Current canonical mappings: {bindings}.
learn_action.title: Learn Pico or keypad actions

learn_already_mapped.description: This physical action is already mapped exactly as requested: {binding}. Nothing new needs to be saved.
learn_already_mapped.title: Action already known

learn_candidate.description: Choose which normalized gesture should mean {action}. Native multi-tap and long-press events are preferred over their underlying press or release events. Existing mappings: {bindings}.
learn_candidate.title: Confirm learned action

learn_conflict.description: This physical action already means {existing}. You attempted to make it {replacement}. Replace the existing effect or return without changing it.
learn_conflict.title: Action already has another effect

learn_error.description: Home Assistant could not start listening safely. No mapping was changed.
learn_error.title: Could not start learning

learn_progress.description: Perform the intended gesture now. Open and Close are accepted only when the target motor-zone update is correlated, then Home Assistant sends a safety Stop. Stop cannot be confirmed by a motor-zone event and is offered after the button events become quiet.
learn_progress.title: Listening for an action

learn_retry.description: Home Assistant did not capture a complete {action} interaction. No partial mapping was saved.
learn_retry.title: Try learning again

learn_start.description: When listening begins, perform the Pico or keypad gesture that should mean {action}. For Open or Close, the motor may move briefly and Home Assistant automatically sends Stop after confirming the target zone. You have ten seconds.
learn_start.title: Learn an action

data_description.close_endpoint_guard_seconds: Extra close time used only for the fully closed endpoint and synchronization. Decimals such as 0.5 are supported.
data_description.close_travel_seconds: Measured time from fully open to fully closed, excluding endpoint guard.
data_description.open_endpoint_guard_seconds: Extra open time used only for the fully open endpoint and synchronization. Decimals such as 0.5 are supported.
data_description.open_travel_seconds: Measured time from fully closed to fully open, excluding endpoint guard.

manual_timing.description: Edit timing for {zone} without moving the motor. Use this expert/recovery path when you already know dependable travel times. Changes are staged until **Save and finish**.
manual_timing.title: Enter timing without calibration

overview.description: {zone}: open {open_time}s; close {close_time}s; endpoint guards {guards}. Timing source: {source}. Standard Picos: {standard_picos}. Canonical mappings: {bindings}.
overview.title: Estimated-position overview

remove.description: Remove estimated percentage support for {zone}. The entity remains available as an Open, Close, and Stop command-only cover. This change is saved immediately.
remove.title: Remove estimated-position support

standard_picos.description: Standard Picos use raise for Open, lower for Close, and favorite for Stop. Current standard Picos: {standard_picos}. All current canonical mappings: {bindings}.
standard_picos.title: Standard Pico remotes

data_description.standard_picos: New remotes are physically verified one action at a time before they are staged. Existing verified mappings are not repeated.

standard_picos_edit.description: Associate standard Pico remotes with {zone}. Current standard Picos: {standard_picos}.
standard_picos_edit.title: Choose standard Pico remotes

verify_binding.description: On {pico}, perform {button} for {action}. Directional verification briefly moves the cover and Home Assistant automatically sends Stop. Nothing is saved until every proposed standard action is verified.
verify_binding.title: Verify standard Pico action

verify_binding_error.description: Home Assistant could not safely start verification. No Pico mapping was changed.
verify_binding_error.title: Could not start verification

verify_binding_progress.description: Perform the requested action on the named Pico now. Home Assistant must see the exact button and gesture; Open and Close also require the target motor-zone update.
verify_binding_progress.title: Listening for standard Pico action

verify_binding_retry.description: The action did not match {button} for {action} on {pico}, or its motor movement could not be confirmed. No mapping was staged.
verify_binding_retry.title: Action was not verified

zone.description: Editing {zone}. Status: {status}. Standard Picos: {standard_picos}. Current canonical mappings: {bindings}. Configure any number of items, then select **Save and finish** once.
zone.title: Estimated cover setup
